said.text: As this city moves toward making universal child care a reality, we need more than just a promise; we need accountability. We do so by making this office and its mandate part of the law. This bill ensures that this office lives through multiple administrations and outlines the coordination that is necessary for child care to be truly accessible and truly affordable.

did.text: Voted Yes on Int 0580-2026, establishing an office of child care and early childhood education in city law. Passed 51–0.

whyNote: Council Member Gutiérrez's statement in the Council's release, associated with Int 580-A, describes codifying the child care office the vote established; she voted yes the same day.
